payload.title: A channel publishes only after the user confirmed it
payload.context: Connecting returns every Page the user granted. Storing them all as active re-activated Pages the user had disconnected. Recorded in docs/platform-notes/meta.md, entry 2026-11-24.
payload.rationale: New or previously disconnected accounts are saved as pending, cannot publish, and are discarded after 15 minutes unless confirmed. Active or needs-reconnect accounts are renewed at once.
alternatives: Hold unconfirmed tokens in the session
Activate everything and let the user disconnect
payload.consequences: A pending token is stored encrypted for at most about 20 minutes. Every future adapter saves through Channel::recordConnection().
